description: This file defines the class PersistableCustomerAttribute which extends CustomerAttributeEntity and encapsulates customer attribute options and values.

classes.name: PersistableCustomerAttribute
classes.description: A Java class representing a persistable customer attribute, including references to customer options and their values.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionValue

methods.name: getCustomerOptionValue

methods.name: getCustomerOption
